The Last Coal is the size of a plum stone and the color of a late bruise. It does not smoke. It does not eat wood. It simply stays warm, as if someone has just spoken a kindness over it.

[[The Ashwardens]] say it was given when [[The Hearth Compact]] was sworn — a guest that agreed to stay. Visitors to the lodge may warm their hands. They may not take it down the hill to [[Ember Reach]], no matter how cold the [[Kiln-Houses|kiln-houses]] have become.
